turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-spend-by-weekday metric, so I cannot give that average; the closest metric is ad_spend_eur, which for 1-30 September 2026 totals EUR 1,060 on Wednesdays and EUR 1,040 on Tuesdays (the highest weekday totals, with different numbers of each weekday in the month), and EUR 820-860 on other days. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
